Method of Attack: multi-stage remote access trojan (RAT) targeting SOHO routers
authentication bypass exploit script to deploy on unpatched routers
network reconnaissance and traffic collection via passive network sniffing
lateral movement to compromise other devices on the network
deployment of additional malicious payloads using DNS and HTTP hijacking
downloading and uploading files, running arbitrary commands, hijacking network traffic, injecting new processes, and gaining persistence on compromised devices
some compromised routers added to a botnet to proxy command and control (C2) traffic
Impacted Systems: SOHO routers (including ASUS, Cisco, DrayTek, NETGEAR)
Attack Vector: exploitation of unpatched SOHO routers via authentication bypass exploit script
